purpose: Create reusable freeform 3D surface forms from deterministic profile extrusion, loft, revolve and tube patterns, including per-part translation, rotation and nonuniform scale, while retaining the exact construction recipe beside the GLB.

properties.path: target .glb file outside the protected live machine body
properties.recipe: axm.form-pattern/v0.1 recipe containing one or more semantic parts

contains: explicit axm.surface-3d/v0.1 positions, normals and triangle indices
semantic parts index with roles and per-part recipe digests
sibling creator-source sidecar retaining the original recipe and compiled specification
explicit visual, rig, animation, collision and engine boundaries

relationships: generalizes authored profile, loft, lathe/revolve and swept-tube patterns already proven in UC specialist assets
uses UC's existing arbitrary explicit surface receiver rather than adding a second GLB encoder
provides a richer shape substrate beneath whole-character recipes
retains construction causes as source authority while treating the GLB as a realization
limitations: This is bounded procedural surface construction, not unrestricted sculpting or arbitrary mesh CSG.
Current patterns are profile-extrude, loft, revolve and tube.
Topology is generated from declared recipes; retopology, UV authoring, texture baking and aesthetic acceptance remain separate capabilities.
A passing GLB/mesh check does not prove rigging, animation, collision, clothing fit, physics or target-engine integration.
